description: Unsafe pod privileges, public storage and ingress are flagged while equivalent safe settings and public egress stay quiet.

files.deploy/unsafe.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: privileged-fixture
spec:
  containers:
    - name: worker
      image: busybox:1.36
      securityContext:
        privileged: true
files.deploy/safe.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: restricted-fixture
spec:
  containers:
    - name: worker
      image: busybox:1.36
      securityContext:
        privileged: false

notes: These deliberately incomplete infrastructure fragments exercise static declarations and settings; they are never deployed.
Public egress is a negative control for the inbound-network rule. Audit expectations cover medium/high rules, not the absence of every possible hardening concern.
